title: CRISPR-Cas9 Ribonucleoprotein-Mediated Genomic Editing in Primary Innate Immune Cells
protocol: Remove spleen(s) from mice and place in a 6-well plate containing 4 mL LHM on ice.
Disrupt spleen using rough sides of two microscope slides within the well.
Squeeze out contents of the spleen by pushing the slides together.
Continue disrupting until the spleen is no longer visibly red.
Pipette liquid through 100 μm nitex mesh covering a 15-mL centrifuge tube on ice.
Centrifuge at 450 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Aspirate fluid above the pellet.
Add 1 mL RoboSep buffer to the pellet and mix well by pipetting up and down for up to 1 x 10^8 nucleated cells (~1 spleen).
Transfer liver tissue to dounce tissue homogenizer using forceps and add 5 mL of PBS.
Dounce liver tissue slowly and firmly.
Transfer homogenized liver into a 15 mL conical tube.
Pellet the homogenized liver by centrifugation at 450 × g for 3 min at 22°C.
Carefully decant supernatant slowly from the pelleted liver.
Resuspend homogenized liver in 5 mL of PBS.
Pellet resuspended liver by centrifugation at 450 × g for 3 min at 22°C.
Resuspend pellet in 3 mL of liver-prep 40% Percoll.
Carefully overlay 3 mL of liver prep onto 60% Percoll using a 5 mL serological pipette to create a gradient.
Allow gradients to settle for 10–15 min.
Centrifuge samples at 800 × g without brake for 15 min at 22°C.
Aspirate top layer of suspension.
Pipet liver leukocytes at the interphase of the gradient into a new 15 mL conical capped with 100 μm nitex mesh to strain debris from cell suspension.
Wash cells with 8 mL PBS and then pellet cells by centrifugation at 800 × g for 5 min.
Resuspend liver leukocytes in 1 mL RoboSep buffer and transfer samples to a 5 mL FACS tube (up to 5 livers can be pooled into 1 mL for isolation).
Obtain 1 EasySep™ Mouse NK Cell Isolation Kit per 10 spleens to be isolated.
Use 5 mL FACS tubes for samples of 1–2 mL and 14 mL round bottom tubes for samples of 2–5 mL.
Resuspend cell suspension using P1000 pipette.
Add 50 μL isolation cocktail per 1 mL sample solution (e.g., 250 μL for 5 mL sample containing 5 spleens).
Cap tube and invert to mix.
Let sit at 22°C for 10 min.
Vortex RapidSpheres™.
Note: Particles should appear evenly dispersed.
Add 100 μL RapidSpheres™ per 1 mL sample solution.
Cap tube and invert to mix.
Let sit at 22°C for 5 min.
Invert every 90 s to keep RapidSpheres™ in solution.
Add RoboSep buffer to top up the sample to the indicated volume.
Mix by gently pipetting up and down 2 to 3 times.
Place the tube (without lid) into the EasyEights™ EasySep™ Magnet and incubate for 5 minutes.
Carefully pipette using P1000 for 5 mL tubes or 10 mL serological, without pouring.
Transfer the enriched cell suspension into a new 15 mL conical tube.
Save 1% of your total volume and check purity by flow cytometry.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 450 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend in 1 mL pre-warmed CR-10 media containing 50 ng/mL recombinant murine IL-15 using P1000 pipette.
Add appropriate volume of CR-10 + IL-15 according to Table 1.
Culture cells for 16–24 hours in TC treated plates according to Table 1.

Proceed to step 36, cRNP Treatment and Electroporation of 24-h-activated Liver Group 1 ILCs Bone-Marrow-Derived cDC1 (BM-cDC1) and Macrophage (BMDM) Production Timing: 3 days for BMDM or 9 days for BMDC1.
Harvest bone marrow Sacrifice mouse and proceed to isolate tibia, fibula, femur.
Cut at the ankle joint and at the hip and then place legs into 6 cm petri dish on ice until ready to remove muscle.
Clean bones prior to crushing Scrape muscle and fat off of leg bones, holding with forceps and scraping with scissors.
Place cleaned bones in 5 mL LHM in 15 mL conical on ice until all bones are cleaned.
Process bone marrow to single cell suspension Wash bones with 5 mL 70% Ethanol (1×) and 5 mL LHM (2×).
Pour into mortar and crush with pestle until bones are white.
Aspirate LHM-bone marrow mixture and pass through 100 μm nitex mesh into new 15 mL conical.
Add another 5 mL LHM and crush bones again, filtering through 100 μm nitex mesh into the same 15 mL conical as before.
Centrifuge bone marrow mixture at 450 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL LHM and add 1 mL ACK lysis buffer.
Lose on ice for 2.5 min.
Centrifuge mixture at 450 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in 10 mL DC or Macrophage media depending on the target cell type.

Plate bone marrow suspension Note: If making BMDC1, add cytokines to DC media: Final concentration 200 ng/mL FLT3-L Final concentration 5 ng/mL GM-CSF Note: Macrophage media already contains the necessary cytokines.
Add 5 mL DC or Macrophage media to two 10 cm non-TC-treated dishes.
Add 5 mL resuspended bone marrow mixture to each dish, making a total of 10 mL in each dish.
Incubate the dishes for 3 days; macrophage precursors are ready for RNP treatment on day 3.
On day 5, add 5 mL DC media (no cytokines necessary) to each dish for BMDC1 production only.
On day 9, conventional dendritic cell precursors (cDCP) are ready for RNP treatment for BMDC1 production.
Mix 2.5 mL DC media into a 1.5 mL tube for each guide to be tested in myeloid cells.
Thaw sgRNA and resuspend each in 15 μL TE Buffer.
Prepare Cas9 master mix by adding 1 μL of 40 pmol/μL Cas9, 5 μL ddH2O per reaction, totaling 6 μL per sample.
Prepare sgRNA master mix for myeloid cells by mixing 1.2 μL guide and 4.8 μL ddH2O per reaction, totaling 6 μL per sample.
Pipette 1.2 μL guide RNA for each condition into the reaction tube.
Add 0.9 μL IDT enhancer to the reaction tube.
Add 3.9 μL ddH2O to the reaction tube to make a total of 6 μL per sample.
Mix 6 μL Cas9 master mix with 6 μL guide master mix in each tube to create RNP complex.
Incubate the RNP complex for 10–15 min at 22°C.
Harvest and count viable cells during the incubation period.
Harvest cDCP using a serological pipette to remove non-adherent cells.
Remove adherent precursors from the dish with a cell scraper for harvesting BMDM.
Harvest Group 1 ILCs using a p1000 pipette ensuring purity of >95% NK1.1+ cells.
Spin down cells at 450 × g for 3 min at 22°C and resuspend in T Buffer.
Add 100 μL cell suspension to 1.5 mL tubes containing complexed cRNP mixes.
Draw up the mixture into a Neon tip and electroporate with settings of 1,900 V for 1 × 20 ms.
Place cells into filled 1.5 mL tubes immediately after electroporation and invert slowly to dilute out T Buffer.
Place 1.5 mL tubes into a rack.
Place the rack with tubes in a 37°C incubator for 90 minutes.
Rack can be placed on its side to prevent T buffer and cells from concentrating at the bottom of the tube.
If using cells in vivo, rest cells for 10–15 minutes in a 37°C incubator after electroporation.
Remove T buffer via centrifugation.
Resuspend cells in PBS for injection.
Fill non-TC-treated plates with respective media.
Place cDCP into a 24-well plate with 1.5 mL DC media and cytokines.
Place BMDM into a 12-well plate with 2.5 mL Macrophage media.
Place Group 1 ILCs into a 48-well plate with 1 mL NK media.
Spin down sample tubes at 450 × g for 3 minutes at 22°C.
Aspirate supernatant from the tubes.
Resuspend cell pellets and place cells into plates.
Wait until cells are mature before isolating genomic DNA or assessing knockout via flow cytometry.
Cells should spend minimal time in T Buffer as it is toxic and will reduce viability.
Analyze innate leukocytes by flow cytometry after electroporation and culturing for the appropriate time.
Conduct Sanger sequencing analysis of innate leukocytes post-electroporation and culturing.
Electroporate cDC1 or macrophages at 1,900 V with a single 20 ms pulse in the presence of Itgax (CD11c) or Itgam (CD11b) cRNP complex respectively.
Compare CD11c expression in BM-cDC1 six days post-electroporation to controls electroporated with Cas9 protein alone.
Compare CD11b expression in BMDM four days post-electroporation to controls electroporated with Cas9 protein alone.
Electroporate Group 1 ILCs at 1,900 V with a single 0.02 s pulse in the presence of Klrb1c (NK1.1) cRNP complex.
Compare NK1.1 expression three days post-electroporation in rmIL-15 pre-activated purified splenic NK cells to controls electroporated with Cas9 protein alone.
Compare NK1.1 expression three days post-electroporation in rmIL-15 pre-activated purified liver ILC1 (TCRβ−CD3ϵ−NK1.1+CD49b−CD200r+) to controls electroporated with Cas9 protein alone.
Prepare fluorophore-conjugated antibody cocktail in 1× PBS.
Harvest innate leukocytes from plating conditions and transfer to 96-well v-bottom plate.
Centrifuge plate at 450 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Flick off supernatant and proceed with surface staining for 30 min at 4°C.
Add 200 μL of 1× PBS to wash excess antibody cocktail.
Centrifuge plate at 450 × g for 3 min at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in desired volume of 1× PBS.
Record data using FlowJo (TreeStar).
Harvest innate leukocytes from plating conditions after electroporation and culturing.
Proceed with DNA isolation using the DNeasy Blood and Tissue kit (Qiagen).
Check purity/concentration of eluted DNA using the NanoDrop OneC Microvolume UV-Vis Spectrophotometer (Thermo Scientific).
Dilute genomic DNA to 50 ng/μL.
Proceed with PCR amplification of cRNP-targeted genomic regions of approximately 500–1,000 base pairs.
Confirm successful PCR reaction by visualizing results via Gel Electrophoresis.
Submit samples for Sanger sequencing (GENEWIZ).
Retrieve .ab1 files once sequencing has been performed.
Analyze InDel Percentage and Knockout score using ICE analysis (SYNTHEGO).
